{"self_assessment": "Impact: I proposed the fish at the start, a recognisable animal made mostly of gentle curves, and the table adopted it. The fish came out clear and fully connected, and the whole run fell from the start domino. I also added a small stretch of dominoes along the back near the head, which stayed connected to the run.

Execution: I inspected the joins several times (around 0:45, 1:15, 2:00, 3:30 and 4:45) to check that the run stayed connected. In the last minutes I kept my hands off so nothing got bumped. The table finished with time to spare and no gaps before the push.

Collaboration: I kept the table informed throughout. I split the work with Sofia, Hana and Omar and stayed out of their strokes once they claimed them. When Hana and Sofia asked me to stay off areas, I did, which avoided collisions. I tried to keep energy up with regular check-ins and credit for good work.

Leadership: I set the direction early by choosing the animal and suggesting how to divide the lines. I then backed the plan Hana sketched rather than competing with it. I kept the group focused on the essentials: a connected run and hands off before the push. I also called the time warnings so everyone stayed aware of the clock.

Overall, I helped the team make a clear decision quickly and finish cleanly. The building was a shared effort, and Hana, Sofia and Omar did most of the dominoes and sketching. My share is around a fifth of the result.", "my_share_percent": 20}
